scores.notes: In both images, Moses (on the rock at left and leading the crowd at right) is the same elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard, weathered tan skin, and a tall sturdy build.

Simon Peter (raising the beggar at left and turning in the courtyard foreground at right) shares the same thick curly salt-and-pepper hair, short full grey-flecked dark beard, weathered olive skin, broad nose, and stocky middle-aged build.

Both images depict the same pebbly Sea of Galilee shoreline with reeds and a smoking campfire, backed by terraced grassy hills with olive and cypress trees and matching pale distant ridges across calm blue water under daylight skies.

The left image shows bright midday under a blue sky with lush leafy green trees around the distant burning house, whereas the right image is pitch-black night with bare winter trees and lanterns even though neither description asks for night.

Alice (standing before the mushroom at left and towering in the courtroom at right) is recognisably the same young girl with long straight golden-brown hair, pale skin, slight build, and compatible young facial features despite the change in expression and angle.

Dr. Watson (standing left of Holmes outside the pawnshop at left and in the doorway at right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with a neat dark-brown mustache, square jaw, light ruddy complexion, and compact build.

Both scenes show the same furrowed green croquet lawn with bent playing-card arches, backed by a low weathered brick-and-stone garden wall, hedges, and tall leafy trees under a bright partly cloudy sky.

Jesus (standing in the boat at left and outside Lazarus's tomb at right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, trimmed full dark beard, olive complexion, early-30s appearance, and slender-medium build.

Daniel (gesturing before the king at left and standing among the lions at right) is the same older man with closely cropped white-grey hair, a neat short grey beard, weathered olive skin, and a medium slender build.
Both views depict the same subterranean bank vault cellar with vaulted brick arches, brick piers, stone-flagstone floors, and stacks of wooden crates illuminated by lantern light.

Sherlock Holmes (seated examining a photograph at left and standing by the doorway at right) is the same tall lean man with slicked-back dark hair, a high receding hairline, a sharp aquiline nose, and a gaunt clean-shaven face.

Both images show the same pebbly lakeshore with a campfire and calm light-blue water bordered by terraced tan-and-green hills dotted with olive trees under a pale morning sky, viewed from shore on the left and from the boat on the right.

Simon Peter (leaping from the boat at left and standing in the courtyard foreground at right) has the same thick curly salt-and-pepper hair, full short dark beard with grey flecks, weathered tanned skin, and muscular stocky build.

Daniel (being hauled up by ropes at left and standing beside the angel at right) is the same older man with closely cropped short grey-white hair, a trimmed grey beard, weathered skin, and a medium build.

Simon Peter (raising the beggar at left and stepping over the boat's gunwale at right) matches in his thick curly dark grey-flecked hair, short full dark beard, weathered tanned complexion, broad nose, and sturdy middle-aged build.

Dr. Watson (seated holding the hat at left and standing beside Holmes outside the shop at right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with a thick dark-brown mustache, square jaw, ruddy light skin, and stocky build.

Sherlock Holmes (standing outside the pawnshop at left and seated at his desk at right) shares the same slicked-back dark hair with a high receding hairline, aquiline nose, gaunt clean-shaven face, and tall slender build.

Both images show the same single-masted wooden planked fishing boat with a billowing cream sail and stern cushion on white-capped stormy waves surrounded by distant shoreline hills under dark rain clouds.

Both panels depict the same dark planked wooden boat with a central mast, tan sail, coiled ropes, and cushioned stern amidst heavy slanting rain, churning dark blue-green waves, and distant rocky hills.

Jesus (walking on the water at left and standing in the boat's stern at right) is the same man in his early thirties with shoulder-length dark brown hair, a full trimmed dark beard, olive skin, and a slender-medium build.

The left image is bright sunny midday with lush leafy green trees clustered behind the burning house, whereas the right image shows dark dusk/twilight lighting and bare leafless winter trees around the house without that dense leafy clump.

Allowing for the storm beginning to break in Mark 4:39 on the right, both images show the same dark wooden planked boat with mast, rigging, and tan sail on the same choppy sea framed by distant coastal hills.

Sherlock Holmes (pulling Watson through the doorway at left and kneeling on the bed striking with a cane at right) has the same slicked-back dark hair with a high hairline, sharp aquiline nose, gaunt clean-shaven face, and tall thin build.

The left image shows a huge, deep circular stone-walled sunken pit with stone stairs, a pillar, and an overhead gallery, whereas the right image shows a tiny narrow well shaft flush with flat open desert sand and a round wooden lid.
Alice (seated at the tea table at left and drinking from the bottle in the hall at right) is the same young girl with long golden-brown hair, pale skin, young rounded features, and slight build.
Jesus (calling outside the tomb at left and standing in the boat at right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, trimmed dark beard, olive complexion, age, and slender-medium build.

David (holding a sling on the right of the left panel and kneeling to be anointed in the right panel) is the same slender teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven youthful features, and light tanned olive skin.
David (kneeling under the oil horn at left and standing with a sling at right) is the same slight teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven youthful face, and light olive complexion.

Jesus (standing by the shore fire at left and walking on the sea at right) is recognisably the same early-30s man with shoulder-length dark brown hair, a neatly trimmed dark beard, olive skin, and matching facial features and build.

Dr. Watson (seated on the chair at left and standing outside the pawnshop at right, both in a bowler hat) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with a thick dark-brown mustache, square jaw, and weathered light complexion.

David (standing with a sling at left and holding a staff by the brook at right) is clearly the same adolescent boy with short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven rosy-cheeked face, light olive skin, and lean youthful build.

Sherlock Holmes (seated on the right of the train carriage at left and pulling Watson through the doorway at right) shares the same slicked-back dark hair, high receding hairline, sharp nose, gaunt clean-shaven face, and slender build.

Both images depict the same sandy, stone-strewn seabed path with shallow puddles and seaweed flanked by towering curling teal walls of parted water, seen from inside the corridor at left and from the rocky shore at right.
In the left image Moses is viewed from behind at a distance on a rocky cliff facing away toward the sea, leaving his face hidden and too small to compare identity features against the right image.

Both panels show the same grassy yard with a long wooden tea table set beneath the overhanging branches of a large gnarled tree on the right, directly in front of the same cream country house with multi-pane sash windows and ivy.

Both scenes show the same rocky, seaweed-strewn seabed corridor dividing towering curling dark-teal walls of water under dark stormy skies, viewed from the shore cliff at left and along the floor of the path at right.

Alice (holding the flamingo at left and standing tall in the courtroom at right) is the same young girl with long golden-brown hair worn with a blue headband, pale complexion, compatible youthful features, and slight build.
David (holding a sling at left and dodging Saul's spear at right) is the same lean teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven youthful face, and light olive skin.

David (dodging the spear beside the falling lyre at left and holding a sling as Goliath falls at right) matches in his short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven adolescent face, tanned olive skin, and slender build.

Simon Peter (leaping from the boat into the sea at left and raising the lame man at right) is the same muscular middle-aged man with thick curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short grey-flecked dark beard, weathered tan skin, and broad features.

Simon Peter (raising the beggar at left and jumping from the boat at right) shares the same thick curly salt-and-pepper hair, full short dark beard with grey flecks, weathered tanned complexion, and sturdy build.

Sherlock Holmes (standing outside the pawnshop at left and kneeling on the bed with a cane at right) is the same tall lean man with slicked-back dark hair, high receding hairline, sharp aquiline nose, and gaunt clean-shaven face.

David (gathering stones by the stream at left and lunging from Saul's spear at right) is the same slender adolescent boy with short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven youthful features, and light olive-tan skin.

Daniel (being helped from the lion pit at left and standing before Belshazzar at right) is the same older man with closely cropped white-grey hair, a short neat grey beard, weathered olive skin, and medium slender build.

Sherlock Holmes (seated on the left bench of the train carriage at left and standing outside the pawnshop at right) shares the same slicked-back dark hair, high receding hairline, sharp nose, gaunt clean-shaven face, and lean build.

David (holding a sling at left and leaping toward the doorway at right) is the same lean teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven rosy-cheeked youthful face, and light olive complexion.
